seo.title: Sunflower Soul: The Mixtape | Sunflower Creative Arts
seo.description: Sunflower Soul: The Mixtape — a celebration of Susan’s love for music. Sunday, September 27, 2026, 6–9 PM at Arts Garage, Delray Beach. Benefiting Sunflower Creative Arts.

hero.title: Sunflower Soul: The Mixtape
hero.lead: One night. All the good things. A celebration of Susan’s love for music! Good music. Great cause. Come ready to dance.

image.alt: Susan Caruso, founder of Sunflower Creative Arts

sections.heading: A celebration of Susan’s love for music!
sections.html:
Come celebrate, connect, and play it forward for Sunflower Creative Arts!

Benefiting Sunflower Creative Arts’ Play, Nature & Arts programs, where children grow through creativity, connection, and playful discovery.

Featuring: Girlfriend Material

sections.heading: What’s in store?
sections.html:
Sunflower Soul begins at 6 PM with a welcoming reception complete with delicious sweet and savory bites, refreshing drinks for purchase, a tribute slideshow, and the soulful sounds of Sunflower alum parent Frank Cerabino on sax.

The evening continues with an unforgettable concert by Girlfriend Material, a high-energy cover band known for bringing your favorite hits to life. From nostalgic throwbacks to today’s favorites, they’ll keep the party going all night long, so get ready to dance the night away!

🎟️ Tickets: $55 general admission – purchase tickets here.

🍷 Cashless bar — credit/debit and mobile payments only | 🍪 All food donated by local supporters

Dress code: Cocktail casual with a nostalgic twist! Feel free to add a touch of ’90s or early 2000s flair, or simply come ready to celebrate, dance, and have a great time.

Let’s honor Susan’s love for music, play, joy and community, and help grow the next generation of creative, connected human beings!

See you there!
